ev.q: NHPI mothers were significantly more likely than Asian mothers to be overweight (23.9% versus 19.5%; p<0.001)
NHPI mothers also were more likely than Asian mothers to smoke during pregnancy (9.8% versus 1.4%; p<0.001)
The DOH birth certificate statistical file was used to calculate population health measures

methods_quotes.q: Comparisons were made using a Pearson chi-square test.
Prevalences are presented for single race and multiracial persons combined
these analyses did not consider the role of potential confounders
